entries.title: 新增《疫苗与抗生素》四单元互动课程
entries.title_en: Added the Vaccines & Antibiotics interactive course
entries.summary: 新增四个单元、九讲的双语互动课程，涵盖病原体、疫苗与免疫应答、抗生素作用机制、耐药性和群体免疫模拟。
entries.summary_en: Added a bilingual interactive course with four units and nine lessons on pathogens, vaccines and immune responses, antibiotic mechanisms, antimicrobial resistance, and population immunity.

links.label: 打开疫苗与抗生素课程

entries.title: 新增极光实验室，探索太阳风与地球磁层
entries.title_en: Aurora Lab explores solar wind and Earth’s magnetosphere
entries.summary: 天文学新增双语 3D 极光实验，可调节地磁活动和粒子能量，观察极光带、带电粒子运动与大气发光层，并提供实验步骤、图表和数据面板。
entries.summary_en: Added a bilingual 3D aurora lab. Adjust geomagnetic activity and particle energy to explore auroral ovals, charged-particle motion, and atmospheric emission, with procedures, charts, and data panels.

entries.title: 新增地质学入口，矿物与岩石归入地质学
entries.title_en: Added Geology and moved Minerals & Rocks
entries.summary: 新增地质学独立入口，并将《矿物与岩石图鉴》归入地质学。原有标本、互动功能与图片来源说明保留。
entries.summary_en: Added a standalone Geology subject and moved the Minerals & Rocks Atlas under it. Its specimens, interactions, and image credits remain available.

entries.title: 新增地球运动与矿物岩石互动专题
entries.title_en: Added Earth science and minerals lessons
entries.summary: 物理学新增《地球的运动与大气》，可模拟地球自转、公转、昼夜、四季与大气分层；化学新增《矿物与岩石图鉴》，可观察 16 种矿物、12 种岩石及其性质、分类与循环。
entries.summary_en: Physics now includes Earth’s Motion & Atmosphere, with interactive models of rotation, revolution, day and night, seasons, and atmospheric layers. Chemistry adds a Minerals & Rocks Atlas featuring 16 minerals, 12 rocks, their properties, classes, and cycle.

links.label: 打开地球的运动与大气

entries.title: 光学实验室加入物理学专题
entries.summary: 新增中英双语光学实验室，包含 11 个互动章节，涵盖光的基础、反射与折射、透镜成像、干涉衍射、光电效应和波粒二象性。
entries.summary_en: Added a bilingual optics lab with 11 interactive chapters covering the nature of light, reflection and refraction, lens imaging, interference and diffraction, the photoelectric effect, and wave-particle duality.

entries.title: 元素周期表互动演示上线
entries.summary: 接入 118 种元素的双语周期表，可搜索元素、查看原子模型与性质，并切换平面和 3D 视图。图片来源面板列出作者、许可与来源链接。
entries.summary_en: Explore all 118 elements in Chinese or English. Search the table, inspect atomic models and properties, and switch between 2D and 3D views. The image credits panel lists authors, licenses, and source links.

entries.title: 溶液与酸碱微观实验台上线
entries.summary: 新增九个可操作场景，涵盖溶液、分散系、溶解度、电离、中和、pH 与方程式配平。
entries.summary_en: Nine interactive scenes explore solutions, dispersions, solubility, ionization, neutralization, pH, and equation balancing.

links.label: 打开溶液与酸碱实验台

entries.title: 细胞与细菌专题继续扩展
entries.summary: 补充植物细胞、动物细胞和细菌图鉴入口与演示截图，细胞图鉴、病毒图鉴等内容也可从生物学专题页继续探索。
entries.summary_en: Added entry cards and lesson previews for plant cells, animal cells, and the bacteria atlas. Continue exploring the cell and virus atlases from the Biology topic page.

entries.title: 新增 2026 诺贝尔奖互动解释
entries.title_en: Added the 2026 Nobel Prize interactive explainer
entries.summary: 用交互模型串联物理学、化学与生理学或医学主题，帮助学生沿着获奖发现提出问题、观察现象。
entries.summary_en: Interactive models connect topics in physics, chemistry, and physiology or medicine, helping students ask questions and observe the ideas behind the discoveries.

links.label: 打开诺贝尔互动实验室
